title: Create a structural framing beam along a line
task: Place a structural framing beam along a Line using Autodesk.Revit.Creation.Document.NewFamilyInstance with a structural framing FamilySymbol, a level and StructuralType.Beam. Covers structural beam modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: A task-phrased search like 'create a structural framing beam along a line' does not surface the creation member; top hits are StructuralFramingUtils.SetEndReference/FlipEnds and BeamSystem.Create.
pitfalls.cause: The creation member is Autodesk.Revit.Creation.Document.NewFamilyInstance(Curve, FamilySymbol, Level, StructuralType); its generic name and summary rank poorly for structural intent (connector issue #341).
pitfalls.fix: Search with the member name, e.g. 'NewFamilyInstance place a beam from a curve with a family symbol level and structural type' (returns it at rank 1), then use the Curve/FamilySymbol/Level/StructuralType overload with StructuralType.Beam.

pitfalls.symptom: NewFamilyInstance creates the instance but it does not render, or an autodesk exception mentions an inactive symbol.
pitfalls.cause: The FamilySymbol was not activated before use.
pitfalls.fix: Call symbol.Activate() inside the transaction when !symbol.IsActive before NewFamilyInstance.

hit.text: NewFamilyInstance place a beam from a curve with a family symbol level and structural type
